WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT tr.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  GROUP BY tr.ordertypedist
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(cnt) as total FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    step1.ordertypedist,
    step1.cnt,
    CAST(step1.cnt AS FLOAT) / step2.total as ratio
  FROM step1
  CROSS JOIN step2
  WHERE step2.total IS NOT NULL
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step3
)
SELECT 
  step3.ordertypedist,
  step3.cnt,
  step3.ratio,
  step3.ratio - step4.avg_ratio
FROM step3
CROSS JOIN step4
WHERE step3.ratio > step4.avg_ratio
